ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

Road Transport (Prohibition of Use of Road)

(City of Kuala Lumpur) (No. 3) Order 2020

Whereas by P.U. (B) 154/2020 published on 28 February 2020, notice was

given of the intention to make an order under section 70 of the Road Transport

Act 1987 [Act 333]:

And Whereas no objection was received by the Commissioner of the City

of Kuala Lumpur against the making of such order:

Now Therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the
